{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Value Momentum Composite", 
"mechanism": "Combining value and momentum strategies can exploit the distinct return drivers of each approach, leading to improved performance.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24.0}, 

{"name": "Quality Growth Dampener", 
"mechanism": "High-quality firms with high growth expectations may experience return reversals, as the market tends to overestimate their future prospects.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18.0}, 

{"name": "Momentum Volatility Buffer", 
"mechanism": "Momentum strategies can be improved by conditioning on low volatility periods, reducing exposure to potential reversals.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom6m"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 12.0}, 

{"name": "Value Yield Enhancer", 
"mechanism": "Combining value and yield strategies can exploit the distinct return drivers of each approach, leading to improved performance.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "NetPayoutYield"}], "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 20.0}, 

{"name": "Growth Quality Filter", 
"mechanism": "High-growth firms with poor quality characteristics may experience return reversals, as the market tends to overestimate their future prospects.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "PS"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 15.0}, 

{"name": "Momentum Reversal Dampener", 
"mechanism": "Momentum strategies can be improved by conditioning on reversal periods, reducing exposure to potential losses.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom6m"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "STreversal"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18.0}, 

{"name": "Value Momentum Yield Composite", 
"mechanism": "Combining value, momentum, and yield strategies can exploit the distinct return drivers of each approach, leading to improved performance.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom12m"}, {"weight": 0.5, "primitive": "NetPayoutYield"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.95, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 12.0}, 

{"name": "Growth Quality Momentum Composite", 
"mechanism": "Combining growth, quality, and momentum strategies can exploit the distinct return drivers of each approach, leading to improved performance.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "PS"}, {"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Mom6m"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 15.0}
]}
